chapter_title: What is Virginal; or, otherwise, what is Continent?
chapter_note: A highly intact five-level descent teaching mapping 'virginal' and 'continent' across cosmic degrees from the eternal kingdom to the human body. The substrate is dominant — the editorial layer is confined to dialogue frame openings (¶1-3) and closure (¶11). The five-fold structure is systematic and self-contained: each level maps the same paired principle (untouched vs. purified-after-mixture) at a successively lower degree. The 'Furthermore' connectives mark degree-transitions within the teaching, not editorial extensions. Notable that ¶9's seam flag fired on bridge connective alone with no institutional vocabulary detected. Negative editorial fatigue (-1.96) confirms the second half is purer teaching, not more editorial. The one genuinely ambiguous element is 'the elect' in ¶9 — potentially institutional, but functioning as a cosmic category in context.

paragraphs.core_text: What is the virgin that is named 'virginal'? Or the [one that] is called 'continent', what is it? Or by what category is the [vi]rgin called 'virginal'? Or [the co]ntinent, which is given this name, by what category is it named '[c]ontinent'?
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed dialogue frame formula: 'Once more, the apostle is sitting down one time among the congregation of his church. He says to his disciples:' — formulaic scene-setting with institutional vocabulary ('congregation of his church').
paragraphs.temporal_note: The substantive question defines the teaching structure — it asks about the CATEGORIES of virginal and continent, which is exactly what the five-level descent teaching answers. The question is the Persian pedagogical tradition setting up a systematic mapping. 'Congregation of his church' is institutional framing.
Pure formulaic disciple response with honorific address ('my master') and flattery ('all good gifts are given to us through you'). No cosmological content whatsoever.

paragraphs.core_text: What is called 'virginal' is assigned to the mystery of the aeons of greatness. And they called it 'virginal' by the category of all the light that did not [taste] of death, nor come to the enemy's war.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed dialogue frame attribution: 'Then speaks our enlightener to them:' — formulaic speaker introduction.
paragraphs.temporal_note: First level of the descent teaching (virginal side). Maps 'virginal' to the light in the aeons of greatness that never entered mixture. Both sides of the mapping stay within the cosmic system: virginal = untouched light. 'They called it' uses impersonal attribution — the teaching received this terminology, it was not coined here.

paragraphs.core_text: However, what is called 'continent' occurs to the mystery of the light that came and was mixed with the darkness. It was defiled in bodies [ ... ] and went up to the light. [They] called [it 'co]ntinent'.
paragraphs.temporal_note: First level (continent side). Maps 'continent' to light that entered Darkness, was defiled, and returned. Classic substrate: cosmic process description with both sides internal. The pairing with ¶3 is systematic — virginal/continent as untouched/purified-after-mixture.

paragraphs.core_text: Furthermore, the holy vir[gin]als [ ... ... ] should they come out against the en[emy ... ... not] taste death, nor [ ... ].
paragraphs.temporal_note: Second level (virginal side). Heavily damaged but the cosmic content is clear: gods who come against the enemy but do not taste death. 'Furthermore' here is a degree-transition marker within the teaching sequence, not an editorial bridge. The content maps cosmos→cosmos.

paragraphs.core_text: On the other hand, what is called 'continent' [is this li]ght that mixed with the darkness, was purif[ie]d, came [up f]rom all the creatures, and was confirmed in the great[ness]. They called it 'continent' since it tasted [of the l]ust; but afterwards was cleansed from it and [become an] holy one.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Second level (continent side). Maps 'continent' to light that mixed, was purified from creatures, and was confirmed in the greatness. The 'tasted of the lust... afterwards was cleansed' formula describes a cosmic process — purification after mixture. Both sides remain within the cosmic system.

paragraphs.core_text: Furthermore, what is called ['vi]rginal' is this light that was purified by the ima[ge] of the [A]mbassador. It wen[t up and] attained [the] he[ights. It was] confirmed in the image of the gods.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Third level (virginal side). Maps 'virginal' to light purified by the Ambassador's image — a specific cosmic event. 'Confirmed in the image of the gods' keeps both sides within the cosmic hierarchy. 'Furthermore' is degree-transition, not editorial extension.

paragraphs.core_text: Again, what is [called] 'continent' is the remainder of this light th[at] remained behind, from what was cleansed. It goes up and comes down in transmigration. Al[so], there is a part [of] it that shall come and attain the form of [hum]an [fl]esh. Again, that one too shall be chosen in the flesh, [accept] the hope, and become an holy one. And they name it 'continent'.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Third level (continent side). Maps 'continent' to light remaining in transmigration. This paragraph begins the descent toward the human level — 'attain the form of human flesh' bridges cosmic and anthropological. The transmigration cycle is a cosmic process. 'Accept the hope' could be editorial overlay but in context describes a stage of the cosmic descent.

paragraphs.core_text: Furthermore, what is named 'virginal' is the Light Mind, should he come and assume the images [of] the ele[ct]. However, on the other hand, what is called 'contin[ent]' is the new man, should it be purified from this old man. And it is cleansed and strips off the Sin that is compounded with it, and it becomes a continent one.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Fourth level (both sides). Maps virginal→Light Mind and continent→new man. The editorial seam flag fired on 'Furthermore' alone — the institutional vocabulary field is EMPTY. The Light Mind is a cosmic entity (divine intellect that descends). The new man / old man is the anthropological correspondence of cosmic purification. 'The elect' is ambiguous — could be institutional or cosmic ('the chosen forms'). In context of the descent structure, I read it as cosmic. Capitalized 'Sin' as personified cosmic entity — 'the sin that is compounded with it' describes the cosmic mixture at the human-soul level.

paragraphs.core_text: And also, what is called 'virgi[n]al' in the flesh, is a man if he has [ne]ver joined himself to woman, has not been defiled by intercourse. However, [i]n contrast, what is called 'continent', is the man who has a wom[a]n in the world. Afterwards, he cleanses himself from her [and] renounces her. And because of this he [ ... ] and he becomes an holy contin[en]t one.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Fifth and final level — the natural/human correspondence. Maps virginal→never joined to woman; continent→joined then renounced. This is the lowest degree of the five-level descent, completing the systematic mapping. Crucially, this paragraph DEFINES ('what is called... IS...'), it does not EXHORT ('you should be...'). The human body is the final register of the cosmic system. 'In the flesh' explicitly marks this as the bodily degree of the same principle. Without this level the five-fold descent is incomplete.

Closure formula. 'Behold, I have taught you' is first-person dialogue frame addressing disciples. The second sentence ('what is virginal, or otherwise what is continent, is in many forms') restates what was shown through the five levels but adds no new teaching content. The chapter's teaching is complete at ¶10.
